# Shaun Porwal

> Personal site of Shaun Porwal: software/ML engineer working across AI agent systems, biomedical data science, and chemical inventory/compliance software. Currently Founder & Engineer at Junto Technologies (cheminventory.co).

## Pages

- [Home / Blog](https://shaunporwal.com/): posts on building, coding, and thinking clearly.
- [About](https://shaunporwal.com/about.html): who Shaun is, contact links.
- [Resume](https://shaunporwal.com/resume.html): full work history, skills, education.
- [Stuff](https://shaunporwal.com/stuff.html): 3D models and other odds and ends.
